_note: Weights sum to 100: the most AI a video could use. A video's score is the sum of weight x level over the categories it used. Tier 1 is the big four (AI wrote it, directed it, generated the picture, generated the sound); mastering is the least.

categories.label: Lyrics & script
categories.hint: who wrote the words: you alone 0, your words with AI tidy-ups 0.25, written with an AI from your brief 0.5, an AI drafting from a one-line idea 0.75, AI unprompted 1

categories.label: Direction & edit
categories.hint: treatment, staging, shot choice, the cut: an AI builds it from your notes 0.5, you only approve 0.75-1

categories.label: Generated video
categories.hint: text/image-to-video models (Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway) or AI restyles of footage; code-rendered animation is NOT this

categories.label: Generated music & vocals
categories.hint: a song or voices generated whole (Suno, Udio) is 1; your own recorded voice, instrument or demo lowers it

categories.label: Generated images
categories.hint: generated stills, plates, cast sheets, sprite sheets, thumbnails; real photos and hand-made art are not

categories.label: Animation & render code
categories.hint: the engine, rigs, camera, physics and shaders written by an AI

categories.label: Tracking, masks & depth
categories.hint: AI models that read or touch up your footage: face/hand tracking, depth maps, masks, background removal, optical flow, upscaling

categories.label: Motion graphics & lyrics
categories.hint: karaoke, cards, titles, lyric timing from whisper

categories.label: Sound effects & foley
categories.hint: synthesised or generated foley, whooshes, stingers

categories.label: Research & critique
categories.hint: fact-checks, reference hunting, Haiku judges, persona reviewers

categories.label: Audio cleanup & stems
categories.hint: demucs stems, de-noise, patching a dropout, splicing takes

categories.label: Audio mastering
categories.hint: loudness levelling, EQ/compression, AI mastering services
